ranking_metric: Debian popcon sourcemax/by_inst installations of the lead's source package
uncertainty: 2 C YAML path(s) pass both schema-neutral YAML controls with the exact typed tree, parser source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback. C YAML libraries return scalars as text with a style and do not resolve plain scalars to types, so the harnesses type plain scalars with the YAML 1.2 core-schema patterns; structure, escapes, block scalars, document markers and alias expansion come from the parser, while the int/float/bool/null distinction is adapter-side. libyaml is the family under PyYAML's CLoader, PHP ext-yaml, Ruby Psych (the controls' cross-check) and Rust unsafe-libyaml, so it is not independent of those paths. Round 2 classified all 90 hits of the bounded Debian source-name search for 'yaml', searched 'yml', 'syck', 'ryml' and 'fkyaml', and looked up C YAML sources without 'yaml' in their names (registry snapshot, round2_debian_search); it found no further C YAML parser library. Excluded leads: libcyaml (schema-mapping layer over libyaml with no generic document API; the caller's schema supplies every type) and tree-sitter-yaml (syntax tree only; see leads.json). Debian installations mostly reflect dependencies and miss vendored copies. The controls do not test tags, merge keys, multi-document streams, complex keys, YAML 1.1-only scalars or malformed input. ISO C documents no YAML API.
selection: Control-verified C YAML paths ranked by Debian popcon sourcemax installations from the pinned snapshot: libyaml 0.2.5 (204,120), libfyaml 0.9.6 (7,482).
